cards.name: Paras
cards.description: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

cards.name: Quilladin
cards.description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

cards.name: Florges
cards.description: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.description: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.description: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Axew
cards.description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.description: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.description: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

cards.name: Noivern
cards.description: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It emerges out of the dark to attack.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It always stand on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.description: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.description: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: It swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity instantly downing foes several times its size.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.

cards.name: Magnezone
cards.description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim's life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

cards.name: Elgyem
cards.description: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

cards.name: Beheeyem
cards.description: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn't faze it.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
